segments.caption: The video opens with the University of Wyoming Extension logo, featuring its iconic bucking horse emblem, set against a clean white background with a band of green grass at the bottom. The phrase “from the ground” begins to appear above the logo, followed by the large, bold word “UP,” which emerges from behind the grass. The video segment opens with an artistic, layered title sequence featuring the text "from the ground UP" superimposed over a stylized image of a wasp nest and green grass. The scene then transitions to a close-up of a real, dark, papery wasp nest with numerous hexagonal cells, some containing developing wasps. A man in a University of Wyoming Extension uniform stands inside a wooden greenhouse, gesturing toward the wall as he speaks. The scene then cuts to an outdoor shot of a wasp nest hanging from a tree branch, with wasps actively moving around it.
A man stands inside a wooden greenhouse, gesturing toward the structure as he speaks, while a separate shot shows wasps actively defending their nest on a tree branch.

A man in a tan University of Wyoming Extension shirt stands inside a wooden greenhouse, gesturing with his left hand toward the wall while holding a small object in his right hand, appearing to explain or demonstrate something about the structure or its contents.

A man from the University of Wyoming Extension stands inside a wooden greenhouse, gesturing toward the structure as he speaks. The scene then cuts to a close-up of a large, active wasp nest attached to the wooden wall, teeming with wasps tending to their hexagonal cells. The video returns to the man, now partially overlaid with the image of the wasp nest, indicating he is discussing the pest issue within the greenhouse environment.

A man in a University of Wyoming Extension shirt stands inside a wooden structure, likely a beehive or apiary, and gestures toward the interior while speaking. The initial frame overlays a honeycomb pattern, but subsequent frames show him clearly, looking down and then up as he explains something about the setup.
A man in a University of Wyoming Extension shirt demonstrates how to safely remove a large wasp or bee nest from the corner of a wooden structure, using a long pole to carefully pry it loose.

A man in a University of Wyoming Extension uniform stands inside a wooden greenhouse structure, holding a long wooden tool and gesturing toward the wall framing as he speaks, likely explaining aspects of the greenhouse's construction or design.

A man in a University of Wyoming Extension uniform stands inside a wooden greenhouse, holding a long-handled tool and gesturing toward the wall as he speaks, likely explaining a gardening or construction technique.

A man in a University of Wyoming Extension uniform stands inside a wooden greenhouse, gesturing toward the wall while holding a small plant sample, likely explaining a gardening or pest management topic. The scene then cuts to a well-stocked store aisle filled with pest control products, suggesting a discussion about available solutions for greenhouse management.

A man in a University of Wyoming Extension shirt stands before a wooden structure, gesturing toward a large, well-stocked shelf filled with various pest control products like Raid, Zero, and Big Yellow Mouse Traps, as he speaks while holding a brush, likely explaining pest management or prevention methods.

A man in a University of Wyoming Extension shirt stands before a wooden structure, holding up a large, intact wasp nest to demonstrate its structure. He gestures toward the nest and the surrounding wood, explaining its features. The scene then transitions to a close-up view through the hexagonal cells of the nest, revealing the intricate internal architecture and the man’s face partially visible behind the wax comb.

A man demonstrates a wasp nest removal process inside a greenhouse, first showing a close-up of the hexagonal nest structure with a wasp nearby, then standing to explain the procedure while holding a tool against the wooden wall.

A man stands inside a wooden greenhouse, gesturing toward the structure’s framework, while the video cuts to a close-up of an empty wasp nest, concluding with credits from the University of Wyoming Extension.

The video opens with a static title card for the University of Wyoming Extension, displaying its logo, contact information, and credits for additional footage from Alan Stanton, Andrew Titus, and Telalnsecta. The card also includes legal disclaimers and the director's name. The scene then transitions to a darker version of the same card, which now adds credits for the host, Jeff Edwards, and the extension media producer, David Keto, before fading to black.
